All /api/ancrid/{portfolio,timeline,passport,collaborations,skills,education,history,achievements,credentials} still 200. SSO clients still 9. ui_bugs.issue: Fixed: MRZ ANCRID segment was rendering the literal string '<' because JSX auto-escapes strings. Changed replace('-', '<') to replace('-', '<<'). Now displays 'ANCRID<<2026<<0001' as intended.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~920 lines; DEMO_JOURNEY joined the existing large seed blocks. Split into /app/backend/seed_data.py before adding another content pack.

_public_projection still returns DEMO_PORTFOLIO/TIMELINE/JOURNEY/ACHIEVEMENTS/SKILLS/CREDENTIALS unconditionally — every /@handle publicly renders the same demo body. Fine for iteration but must be per-user before real onboarding.
PublicCreator.jsx MRZ construction relied on '<' string literals which React escapes; watch for the same mistake elsewhere when authoring passport chrome.
Timeline.jsx renders anchor jumps (#chapter-CODE) but no aria-labels on the chapter node buttons — add for a11y.
Verified seal uses infinite CSS animation (spin 18s) — respect prefers-reduced-motion for accessibility.
Sidebar auto-generates data-testid from labels via kebab-case; safe for now but rename discipline requires coordinated test/testid update — consider decoupling testid slug from label.
seed_data_creation: None new. Regression signup creates transient test_h_<ts>@ancr.io users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three pytest files at /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (iter1, 27), test_iter2.py (12), test_iter3.py (14). BASE_URL falls back to preview URL if env var missing. Frontend labels 'Connected Ecosystem' and 'Creator Journey' produce data-testids nav-connected-ecosystem and nav-creator-journey via kebab-case slug in Sidebar.jsx. MRZ on PublicCreator.jsx uses '<<' as separator; when validating in Playwright, be aware inner_text respects CSS text-transform:uppercase, so string checks should use the uppercase form (e.g., 'CREATIVE IMPACT' not 'Creative Impact').
